facts.statement: Parsing the two-item tuple [string, string.default('fallback')] with the one-item input ['present'] returns the one-item output ['present'] with length 1.

diagnosis.root_cause: The tuple parser classifies every absent position at or beyond its optional-input boundary as skippable, including schemas that produce a defined output from absent input.

plan.behavioral_objective: Materialize an omitted tuple position when its schema produces a defined output, while continuing to omit trailing positions whose output is genuinely optional.
constraints: Preserve explicit undefined values that were present in the input.
Preserve rest-item handling and issue ordering.
Keep synchronous and asynchronous item parsing behavior equivalent.
non_goals: Do not change object-property default behavior.
